prompt: The virus behind this disease was identified in 1964 from tumor samples flown out of Uganda to London, on a flight diverted by fog to Manchester, which the researchers later thought had probably saved the specimens. While this disease is usually mild and self-limited, the same virus also causes the cancer the original samples came from, and it infects most of the human species without incident.
